content.title: 1. Introduction
descriptions: Carbon Copy Labs LLC operates the Assemble game and website to provide services including game services, e-commerce, social media, news distribution, and information services.

Carbon Copy Labs LLC is committed to protecting users' privacy and addressing potential privacy concerns. The following information has been posted to help you, the consumer, understand what private information we collect and how your information is used.
To best serve your needs, we collect the following types of information when you visit the Assemble game or website.

content.title: 2. Personal information
descriptions: We collect the following personal information from our users: account names from game publishers, billing address, and mailing address.

You can always choose to provide less information. However, omitting some of this personal information may limit your ability to access all of the benefits of our website and services. For example, we will not be able to process transactions without payment information and a billing address, or ship goods without your name and mailing address.

content.title: 3. Automatically collected information
descriptions: We automatically collect data on how our users visit the Assemble game or website, such as your IP address, location, browser, browser language, operating system, device identifiers, user tags, gamer information, Steam information, Oculus information, and cookies.
Our website currently uses cookies to enhance its functionality. You may disable cookies in your web browser, but this may limit your ability to access the Assemble website.

content.title: 4. Social media information
descriptions: If you've linked your Carbon Copy Labs LLC account with a social media, Steam, or Oculus account, we also collect information social media networks give us. Depending on the social media network, this can include your username, name, email address, friends list, and more. In addition, we collect demographic data when users interact with Carbon Copy Labs LLC social media accounts.

content.title: 5. Policy on collecting sensitive personal information
descriptions: Carbon Copy Labs LLC does not gather any of your sensitive personal information, such as your social security number, driver's license number, race, ethnicity, religion, health metrics, political associations, or details on your criminal background.

content.title: 6. How the information collected is used
descriptions: We only use your personal information to help you utilize everything the Assemble game and website have to offer. This includes:

Creating and maintaining an account with us. Contacting you regarding updates to our company policies. Making all of Carbon Copy Labs LLC' services available to you in a convenient manner. Evaluating analytics to see how our customers engage with the Assemble game and website. Completing your transactions.

content.title: 7. Length of time personal information is stored
descriptions: We may store your personal information for an extended period of time, depending on how we need to use the information. For example, we'll keep your email address and name on file as long as you have an account with us. In addition, we may need to keep your billing information on file for an extended period of time to maintain our internal transaction records.

content.title: 8. Who the information is shared with
descriptions: We may share your information with third parties, but only those affiliates that Carbon Copy Labs LLC has fully vetted and created a partnership with. For more information about our affiliates, please visit this link.

The only reason we will ever share your information with affiliates is for the following purposes: Processing transactions; Providing excellent customer service; Issuing email and text message communications.

content.title: 9. Information Security
descriptions: We do our best to keep your private information secure and safe. Most of your personal information is encrypted and is therefore protected from being accessed by outside users. However, data leaks and malicious attacks do happen. Please understand that while we do our best to protect your data, providing your personal information is at your own risk.

content.title: 10. Ability to decline to provide personal information
descriptions: You can, of course, decline to disclosure your personal information to us. However, the failure to provide us with pertinent information may limit your ability to fully benefit from Carbon Copy Labs LLC and all of its offerings. Remember, we only ask for personal information that can help us fully provide our services to our customers.

content.title: 11. How to delete your personal information
descriptions: You can delete your user data that has been collected or stored by emailing our manager directly at zach@carboncopylabs.com. We will promptly delete your personal information when requested.

content.title: 12. Policy updates
descriptions: This privacy policy was last updated on 9/13/2023. If we adjust the privacy policy, we will email all account holders of this change and post the most recent update date here. Once posted, the new privacy policy shall be effective immediately.
